# Know where your visitors come from. Keep the data.

> Free, self-hosted, cookie-free web analytics: visitors, sources, UTM campaigns and goals with revenue by source. An source-available alternative to Plausible, Fathom and Simple Analytics. MIT, zero dependencies.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
